burn.name: Burn
burn.description: Deals fire damage equal to 3x stacks at the start of the holder's turn.

frost.name: Frost
frost.description: No effect on its own — a resource stat consumed by "shatter" combos for bonus fire damage.

regen.name: Regeneration
regen.description: Heals a flat amount at the start of the holder's turn.

tribulation.name: Tribulation
tribulation.description: Banked lightning charge on the Tribulation Ascendant (Party 2). Funneled by allies acting and by the Ascendant taking damage; consumed by Ninefold Descent for a stacksConsumed-scaled detonation.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.description: Bleed-marker banked on enemies by the Blood-Path Demon Cultivator party (Party 5). Consumed by Rupture for a stacksConsumed-scaled detonation.

fox_fire.name: Fox Fire
fox_fire.description: Banked spirit-flame charge for the Nine-Tailed Fox Illusionist party (Party 6). Built by row changes; consumed by Illusory Collapse / Mirror Burst for stacksConsumed-scaled detonations.

wuxing_harmony.name: Wuxing Harmony
wuxing_harmony.description: Banked convergence charge on the Wuji Taiji Core (Party 7). Funneled by every elementalist acting; consumed by Taiji Nova for a stacksConsumed-scaled detonation.

sword_wound.name: Sword Wound
sword_wound.description: Marking counter applied by the Flying-Sword Echo (Party 1) on a crit. A resource other kits can read via hasStatus.

grounded.name: Grounded
grounded.description: Marking counter applied by the Grounding Sentinel (Party 2) to whoever hits it.
